name: Pallet Town
summary: Your home town. Select your starter Pokémon from Professor Oak's Laboratory, withdraw the bedroom PC Potion, and claim the Town Map from Daisy after delivering Oak's Parcel.

items.name: Potion
items.method: Withdrawn from player's PC bedroom item storage

items.name: Town Map
items.method: Gifted by Daisy in the rival's house after delivering Oak's Parcel

trainers.name: Rival Blue (Lab Battle)
trainers.strategy: Spam your primary attack (Tackle/Scratch). Use Growl or Tail Whip on turn 1 to win the damage race.
